notes: Peer-reviewed PNAS article (abstract + full text verified 2026-10-11). Key abstract claims used: late-Holocene aridification after ~5,000 BP stabilized fluvial landscapes; urbanism flourished ~600 y in western Indo-Gangetic Plain; after ~3,900 y ago settled area/site sizes declined with eastward shift; Ghaggar-Hakra active rivers in Holocene were monsoon-fed, not a large glacier-fed Himalayan river; hydroclimatic stress linked to agricultural vulnerability and settlement change. Author summary frames Early Phase ~5,200–4,500 y ago and Mature ~4,500–3,900 y ago (BP-style). Treat climate–collapse linkage as a scholarly model with multi-causal room — not sole deterministic cause.
